# Short use case fixture (~500 chars)

Build a **booking management** app for a boutique hotel.

## Primary users
- Front desk staff who manage reservations
- Hotel managers who review occupancy

## Core workflow (happy path)
1. Staff searches for a guest by name or confirmation code
2. Staff views booking details and updates room assignment
3. Manager exports daily occupancy summary

## Success criteria
- Search returns results in under 2 seconds
- All booking changes are auditable
